queries.sql: SELECT `staff`.*, `location`.`location_name`, IFNULL(FORMAT(staff_advance.total_advance, 2), "0.00") as total_advance, `driver_assignment`.`from_date`, `driver_assignment`.`to_date`, `driver_assignment`.`vehicle_no` as `assignment_vehicle_no`, `driver_assignment`.`opening_hsd`, `driver_assignment`.`closing_hsd`, `vehicle`.`vehicle_no`, `adjust_salary`.`amount`, `adjust_salary`.`remark` FROM `staff` LEFT JOIN `location` ON `location`.`location_id` = `staff`.`address` LEFT JOIN `adjust_salary` ON `adjust_salary`.`driver_id` = `staff`.`id` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `sa`.`staff_id`, COALESCE(SUM(sa.amount), 0) AS total_advance FROM `staff_advance` `sa` INNER JOIN (SELECT `driver` AS `staff_id`, `from_date`, `to_date`, `vehicle_no`, `opening_hsd`, `closing_hsd` FROM `driver_assignment` WHERE `driver_assignment`.`from_date` <= '2025-11-30' AND `driver_assignment`.`from_date` >= '2025-11-01') AS da ON `da`.`staff_id` = `sa`.`staff_id` WHERE `sa`.`adv_date` >= `da`.`from_date` AND `sa`.`adv_date` <= `da`.`to_date` GROUP BY `sa`.`staff_id`) AS staff_advance ON `staff_advance`.`staff_id` = `staff`.`id` LEFT JOIN (SELECT `driver` AS `staff_id`, `from_date`, `to_date`, `vehicle_no`, `opening_hsd`, `closing_hsd` FROM `driver_assignment` WHERE `driver_assignment`.`from_date` <= '2025-11-30' AND `driver_assignment`.`from_date` >= '2025-11-01') AS driver_assignment ON `driver_assignment`.`staff_id` = `staff`.`id` LEFT JOIN `vehicle` ON `vehicle`.`id` = `driver_assignment`.`vehicle_no` WHERE `driver_assignment`.`staff_id` IS NOT NULL AND `staff`.`user_type` = 'DRIVER' AND `staff`.`id` = '28' GROUP BY `staff`.`id`, `driver_assignment`.`from_date`

SELECT `do_registration`.`do_no`, `despatch`.`vehicle_no`, `do_registration`.`do_registration_id`, `driver_assignment`.`driver`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses1`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses2`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses3`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses4`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses5`, `do_registration`.`trip_expenses6`, DATE(despatch.des_date) as despatch_date, `doprice_change`.`trip1` as `doprice_trip1`, `doprice_change`.`trip2` as `doprice_trip2`, `doprice_change`.`trip3` as `doprice_trip3`, `doprice_change`.`trip4` as `doprice_trip4`, `doprice_change`.`trip5` as `doprice_trip5`, `doprice_change`.`trip6` as `doprice_trip6`, SUM(despatch.quantity) as total_weight, COUNT(despatch.despatch_id) as total_number_of_trip FROM `despatch` LEFT JOIN `do_registration` ON `do_registration`.`do_registration_id` = `despatch`.`do_no` LEFT JOIN `doprice_change` ON `do_registration`.`do_registration_id` = `doprice_change`.`dono` AND `despatch`.`des_date` >= `doprice_change`.`from_date` LEFT JOIN `driver_assignment` ON `driver_assignment`.`vehicle_no` = `despatch`.`vehicle_no` WHERE `despatch`.`vehicle_no` = '75' AND YEAR(despatch.des_date) = '2025' AND MONTH(despatch.des_date) = '11' AND `driver_assignment`.`driver` = '28' AND despatch.des_date >= driver_assignment.from_date AND despatch.des_date <= driver_assignment.to_date GROUP BY DATE(despatch.des_date), `driver_assignment`.`driver`
